nodes.description: Public token name string, set once in the constructor to "Tether USD".
Public token symbol string, set once in the constructor to "USDT".
Public uint8 token decimals, set once in the constructor to 6.
Public uint256 total token supply, initialized in the constructor to 100000000000000000000000000.
mapping(address => uint) holding per-account token balances; read and written by transfer/transferFrom and read by balanceOf/totalSupply.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) holding ERC20 allowances; written by approve and consumed by transferFrom.
Constructor: sets name/symbol/decimals, mints _totalSupply to msg.sender and emits Transfer.
Returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] using an unchecked raw subtraction.
View function returning balances[tokenOwner].
View function returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval; no allowance-reset or zero-address guard.
Debits msg.sender and credits to using safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer.
Debits from, reduces allowed[from][msg.sender] via safeSub and credits to via safeAdd; emits Transfer.
SafeMath addition helper reverting on overflow.
SafeMath subtraction helper requiring b <= a before a - b.
SafeMath multiplication helper with overflow check.
SafeMath division helper requiring b > 0.
Caller-controlled address used as initial supply recipient, allowance owner, balance holder and spender in transferFrom.
Unchecked arithmetic expression _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] in totalSupply(), which can underflow because it bypasses SafeMath.
address tokenOwner parameter of balanceOf.
address tokenOwner parameter of allowance.
address spender parameter of allowance.
address spender parameter of approve.
uint tokens parameter of approve, written into allowed[msg.sender][spender].
address to parameter of transfer, credited via safeAdd.
uint tokens parameter of transfer, debited via safeSub.
address from parameter of transferFrom, debited via safeSub.
address to parameter of transferFrom, credited via safeAdd.
uint tokens parameter of transferFrom, debited from from and from the allowance.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the recipient of the initial _totalSupply balances entry in the constructor.
msg.sender keys allowed[msg.sender][spender] in approve, making the allowance owner caller-controlled.
msg.sender is the source balance debited by safeSub in transfer.
msg.sender is used as the spender whose allowance allowed[from][msg.sender] is consumed in transferFrom.
totalSupply() reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply() reads balances[address(0)] as the subtrahend of an unchecked subtraction.
balanceOf returns balances[tokenOwner] from the balances mapping.
allowance returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender] from the allowed mapping.
approve writes the tokens value into the allowed mapping.
transferFrom reads and decreases allowed[from][msg.sender].
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping for msg.sender and to.
transferFrom reads and writes the balances mapping for from and to.
_totalSupply is the left operand of the unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)].
balances[address(0)] is the right operand of the unchecked subtraction and can exceed _totalSupply, causing underflow.
The unchecked subtraction executes inside totalSupply() and its result is returned directly.
transfer invokes safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transfer invokes safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom invokes safeSub for the from balance and the allowance.
transferFrom invokes safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
Constructor assigns the literal "Tether USD" to the name state variable.
Constructor assigns the literal "USDT" to the symbol state variable.
Constructor assigns 6 to the decimals state variable.
Constructor sets _totalSupply to the initial mint amount.
Constructor credits balances[msg.sender] with _totalSupply.
approve writes the requested allowance into the allowed mapping.
transfer writes the updated sender and recipient balances back into the balances mapping.
transferFrom writes the updated from and to balances into the balances mapping.
transferFrom writes the reduced allowance back into the allowed mapping.
The tokenOwner parameter indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
The tokenOwner parameter is the outer key of the allowed lookup in allowance.
The spender parameter is the inner key of the allowed lookup in allowance.
The spender parameter is the inner key written by approve.
The tokens parameter is the allowance value stored by approve.
The to parameter is the recipient credited via safeAdd in transfer.
The tokens parameter is the amount debited via safeSub in transfer.
The from parameter is the source account debited in transferFrom.
The to parameter is the recipient credited in transferFrom.
The tokens parameter is the amount withdrawn from balance and allowance in transferFrom.

normalization_plan.reason: The parameter exists only to index balances inside balanceOf and has no independent identity.
The parameter is only used as the outer mapping key inside allowance.
The parameter is only used as the inner mapping key inside allowance.
The parameter is only used as the allowance key inside approve.
The parameter is only used as the stored allowance value inside approve.
The parameter is only used as the credited account inside transfer.
The parameter is only used as the debited amount inside transfer.
The parameter is only used as the debited source account inside transferFrom.
The parameter is only used as the credited account inside transferFrom.
The parameter is only used as the amount removed from balance and allowance inside transferFrom.
